status: parameters frozen before held-out mask evaluation
primary_hypothesis: At fixed J=0.7 and T=1.25, the Gamma=0.35 transverse-field model has a positive mean paired missing-pixel PSNR difference relative to the Gamma=0 classical-Ising control.
primary_endpoint: paired PSNR difference in dB: quantum minus classical Ising
estimation: mean paired difference and percentile bootstrap 95% confidence interval
decision_rule: Call the held-out result statistically positive only if mean delta > 0, the bootstrap 95% interval excludes zero, and the two-sided paired t-test p-value is below 0.05.
no_tuning_rule: No J, T, Gamma, patch shape, field strength, or mask seed may be changed after evaluation starts.
interpretation_limit: A positive result is evidence for a transverse-field contribution within this exact quantum-model simulation. It is not evidence of computational quantum advantage or quantum-hardware performance.
